title: Experiment flight recorder
scenario: I15. Capture a bounded episode, inspect its last sample, reopen the saved observation window and identify an incomplete capture.
host: macOS 27.2.1 arm64, T3 Code collaborative preview, Chromium 152.0.7977.169
fixture: bench-probe/1, seed 37, 24 logical ticks, 12 retained; see ../episode.json and ../missing.json
reproduce:
PYTHONPATH=python python3 examples/flight-recorder/app.py --port 18175
Open http://127.0.0.1:18175/ and follow each slide's action. Start at 1280 x 800 CSS pixels. Resize to 1000 x 1100 for slides 2–4.

slides.caption: Instrument ready
slides.expected: The viewer offers capture and reopen, with no recorded episode displayed.

slides.caption: Inspect the last retained reading
slides.action: Capture an episode, click the sample slider and press End.
slides.expected: Tick 23 reads 32. Request probe-peak/16 returned 84. The viewer reports 12 dropped observations.

slides.caption: Reopen the saved episode
slides.action: Save the JSON, reload the viewer and choose the downloaded episode.json.
slides.expected: The reopened file plots the retained observations, starts inspection at tick 12 with reading 25, and displays the recorded peak of 84.

slides.caption: Investigate an incomplete episode
slides.action: Select Omit async result, capture and save. Remove the tick 13 sample from the saved JSON and reopen it as missing.json.
slides.expected: The plot contains 11 samples. The status identifies tick 13 as missing, and the async panel explains that the peak cannot be replayed.
